description:
Neverwinter’s 34th module, Sleeping Gods Lie, is now available!

In this major update for the free-to-play Dungeons & Dragons MMORPG, adventurers join legendary dwarf king Bruenor Battlehammer in the new Reghed Crevasse Adventure Zone and venture into Ythryn, the lost Netherese city first introduced in Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, as a reality-warping madness spreads beneath the glacier. Sleeping Gods Lie also introduces the Madness of the Sleeping God zone mechanic and The Devourer's Pit Trial.

Neverwinter is a free, action MMORPG based on the acclaimed Dungeons & Dragons fantasy roleplaying game. Epic stories, action combat and classic roleplaying await those heroes courageous enough to enter the fantastic world of Neverwinter!
